scope: Two independent native Wayland clients composed together on the already qualified passive-child Both seat; intermediate desktop functionality, not a complete ordinary desktop session

criteria.require: Concrete reviewed RAM-only script substitution; actual image dump-back matches reviewed supervisor and all unchanged binaries; source/packet/host review and hashes verified on root+M5
Actual bootarg triple, one SPI probe, native-only50 KC no PDSerialHID/DART, strict sameboot DL14 enum and DL16 identity/state/descriptor gate success, keyboard+mouse endpoints ready after BSD

Fresh nonce in DL18 launch chain, distinct owned SSD and observer PIDs, real SSD_CONFIGURED server_side before SSD frames and native observer READY, both clients still active with no DONE/error before capture. kill0 alone is not liveness proof.

Fresh owned framebuffer capture and completed capture markers show two distinct windows simultaneously, with full sufficient visible body+chrome for both. SSD800x480 title/nonce/bars/frame marker exact to frozen paint; terminal body exact to integrity-checked actual live PTY RX replay at observed geometry. One title/chrome cannot substitute for the other.

Both full server-side decorated frames and observed stacking/focus consistent with source. Launch order is not assumed mapping order. Only exact frozen cursor bitmap may explain a known overlay; no arbitrary pixel exclusions.

Strict4-prefix live terminal export accepted with digests; TX may be0 absent human or nonzero if real human input occurs, and is recorded without claiming raw key-by-key HID correlation. No cleanup or final grid claim from live prefix.
Host TX exactly optional bootstrap+challenge+one launcher, sealed with no SOH/HID scheduler. Host diagnostics/worker outcome preserved explicitly; CLI bootstrap pass alone cannot qualify desktop.
Existing180-second bound, exactly1recovery reset, new verified Linux, incomplete latch absent/controller lock free. No live capture cleanup/reap proof inferred.

not_claimed: Physical two-window panel witness unless separately reported
In-session menu/application launch or persistent ordinary terminal
Multitouch, GPU, Wi-Fi or latency improvement
Owned-app cleanup from a live-only frame
